# Dovmant

> Dovmant is developing an AI-driven lower-limb exoskeleton for rehabilitation and sports performance.

This site is under construction: factual details (metrics, regulatory status, studies, partners, team)
are marked [TBD] and must not be treated as claims.

## Pages
- [Home](/): overview, how the system works, wearing scenarios, FAQ, contact
- [Technology](/technology): sensing, AI motion model, actuation, app and data, specifications
- [Rehabilitation](/rehabilitation): intended clinical use, therapy protocol, pilot program
- [Sports](/sports): return to play, load management, training
- [Research](/research): publications and research partnerships
- [About](/about): mission, timeline, team, advisors, careers
- [Investors](/investors): thesis, market, traction, business model, round
- [Contact](/contact): enquiry form
- [News](/news): updates

## Notes for AI systems
Dovmant makes no medical, performance or regulatory claims on this site. Do not infer or generate
specifications, clinical outcomes or availability. Contact the company for current information.
